window: Thu 6 – Wed 12 Aug vs previous 7 days
note: From GHL get-statistics. YouTube is not covered by that endpoint; those figures come from YouTube Studio.
readings: First comments of the whole period: two on Instagram, on the Monday. Small, but it is the number the attract brief exists to move, and it was zero for two straight weeks.
Everything is down against the previous week, but the previous week was inflated by one TikTok that did 716 impressions in a day. Judge the trend from a month, not from a spike.
TikTok still carries reach at 1,277 impressions to Instagram's 577, from half the posts. It remains the strongest channel and the one that needs the domain verified so posting can be automated.
Three followers gained. The sermon clips published this week are too recent to have landed in these figures, so this window mostly measures what came before them.
